name: SQL Injection
description: User-controlled input is incorporated into SQL queries without proper sanitization or parameterization.
fix: Use parameterized queries: cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = %s', (user_id,))

name: OS Command Injection
description: User input is passed unsanitized to shell commands, allowing arbitrary OS command execution.
fix: Use subprocess with a list of arguments and shell=False: subprocess.run(['ping', host], shell=False)

name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
description: Untrusted user input is rendered in HTML without proper escaping, allowing script injection.
detection_patterns: | safe filter on user input in Jinja2
fix: Escape all user-supplied data before rendering in HTML. Use template auto-escaping.

name: Path Traversal
description: User-supplied path input is used to access files outside the intended directory.
fix: Validate and sanitize file paths. Use os.path.basename() and check the resolved path stays within the allowed directory.

name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
description: Deserializing attacker-controlled data can lead to arbitrary code execution.
fix: Never deserialize untrusted data with pickle. Use yaml.safe_load() instead of yaml.load().

name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
description: Credentials, API keys, or secrets are embedded directly in source code.
fix: Store secrets in environment variables or a secrets manager. Never commit credentials to version control.

name: Use of Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
description: Use of deprecated or weak cryptographic algorithms that can be broken by attackers.
fix: Use bcrypt/argon2/scrypt for passwords. Use SHA-256+ for hashing. Use secrets module for random tokens.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
description: The application fetches remote resources using user-supplied URLs without adequate validation.
fix: Validate URLs against an allowlist. Block requests to private IP ranges (10.x, 172.16.x, 192.168.x, 169.254.x).

name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
description: A critical function or endpoint is accessible without authentication.
detection_patterns: no session validation before privileged operation
fix: Enforce authentication on all sensitive endpoints using decorators, middleware, or guard clauses.

name: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File
description: Passwords, tokens, or other sensitive data are written to log files.
detection_patterns: logger.debug() with full request body including credentials
fix: Never log passwords, tokens, or PII. Sanitize user input before logging to prevent log injection.

name: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information
description: Error messages or stack traces expose internal implementation details to the user.
detection_patterns: verbose error handler sending stack trace
fix: Catch exceptions and return generic error messages. Log full details server-side only.
